cue: A producer reconnects, restarts, or fails while callers retain references to files it yielded; reusing names or broad cleanup can overwrite or delete earlier results.
lesson: Establish when ownership transfers from the producer to its caller and which accepted outputs must remain readable. Use a private staging directory per capture and publish only completed files under unique names; do not restart a shared filename counter where earlier references must remain valid. Stop and wait for the producer before cleaning its unyielded staging files, including on early iterator closure and startup failure. Explicitly close the iterator when consumer processing fails. Track whether the current item was accepted: remove rejected or unkept items, but preserve accepted retained items even if a later callback fails. Clean only files owned by the current operation and remove shared directories only when empty; preserve earlier outputs and unrelated contents. Propagate cleanup failures. Test retained bytes as well as paths across reconnects, normal completion, early close, producer and consumer failures, and repeated rejected items. Follow the current retention contract; this does not imply permanent retention for every artifact or a general transaction guarantee.
evidence: Public project albertoelopez/yt-transcribe, merged commit 82992e1a67d37aa345fc328f906a474f28032002 (PR #1). Live capture reused frame filenames across reconnects. The fix stages each capture privately, publishes completed images under unique names, explicitly closes capture on consumer failure, and scopes cleanup to owned files. Public regressions in tests/test_frame_reconnect_public.py include test_reconnect_keeps_earlier_images and test_unkept_run_preserves_preexisting_files. tests/test_live_frame_ownership.py adds test_capture_transfers_only_yielded_images, test_process_start_failure_cleans_capture, test_cleanup_failure_propagates_after_process_stops, test_real_repeated_capture_has_new_bytes, test_live_error_ownership, and test_reconnect_rejection_preserves_accepted_bytes. Together these provide 20 cases. The applied full unit and e2e suite passed 287 tests with one existing ffmpeg drawtext skip. These are public production regressions, not private evaluation material.
confidence: Verified for this project's live-frame lifecycle. The selected implementation came from a lesson-disabled coding attempt. The new retention lesson has not undergone a transfer comparison, and no reliability improvement is attributed to it. Applicability depends on the current task's publication, ownership, and retention requirements.
